rd_design_review_decision_time.name: rd_design_review_decision_time
rd_design_review_decision_time.value: ("rd_design_review"."status" = 'PENDING' and "rd_design_review"."decided_at" is null) or ("rd_design_review"."status" != 'PENDING' and "rd_design_review"."decided_at" is not null)

rd_spec_feature_unique.name: rd_spec_feature_unique

rd_task_authorization_revoked_time.name: rd_task_authorization_revoked_time
rd_task_authorization_revoked_time.value: ("rd_task_authorization"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "rd_task_authorization"."revoked_at" is not null) or ("rd_task_authorization"."status" != 'REVOKED' and "rd_task_authorization"."revoked_at" is null)
